structure: Social studies standards with a common layout: u1 = course title; first table = 'Inquiry Standards' (Anchor Standards 1-5, codes SS.6-8.n.m, anchor standard names split across rows of C1); then numbered Themes. Each Theme: a header row (Theme N + title), 'Sample Compelling Questions' row (label split into 'Sample Compelling' / 'Questions' cells plus bullets), a 4-column table header (Anchor Standard / Topic / Content Standard / Sample Content/Concepts), 'The student demonstrates an understanding of' / 'Therefore, the student is able to' sub-header, then rows: C1 discipline (History/Civics/Geography/Economics) with Anchor Standard number and name split into following C1 rows, C2 topic, C3 'Content Standard SS.7PI.t.a.n' statement, C4 bullet sample content/concepts. Middle school course 'Pacific Island Studies' (codes SS.7PI).
